headline: Coral India Finance reports an 8.3 percent decline in Q1 net profit to Rs 4.41 crore
hook: Profit dips at Coral India Finance
summary: Coral India Finance posted a net profit of Rs 4.41 crore for the first quarter, representing an 8.3 percent decrease compared to the same period previous year. The company's financial update details the quarterly earnings performance for stakeholders. Retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap financial firm experience a softer quarterly bottom line.
